source_caption:
Waves (2019) is one of those films that quietly stays with you long after it ends. Directed by Trey Edward Shults, it follows a family dealing with love, loss, mistakes, and forgiveness. The story takes an unexpected turn halfway through, giving you two very different but equally powerful perspectives.

With incredible performances from Kelvin Harrison Jr., Taylor Russell, Sterling K. Brown, and Alexa Demie, along with stunning cinematography and an amazing soundtrack, Waves delivers an emotional experience that feels both intimate and unforgettable. If you’re looking for a heartfelt coming of age drama, this is one you shouldn’t miss.

source_details.synopsis: Waves is a 2019 American psychological drama film written, produced and directed by Trey Edward Shults. Along with Shults, it was produced by Kevin Turen and James Wilson. It stars Kelvin Harrison Jr., Taylor Russell, Lucas Hedges, Alexa Demie, Renée Elise Goldsberry, and Sterling K. Brown. It traces the emotional journey of a suburban American family as they navigate love, forgiveness and coming together in the wake of a tragic loss. Principal photography began on July 9, 2018, in Broward County, Florida and wrapped up on August 24, 2018. The cast was announced in July, with Demie joining in August.
